description: Show the user a visual preview of a design system from the catalog (use the id from 'find-design-system'). Returns a token-true HTML preview: palette, typography, buttons, card, input, badge, plus a link to the full live showcase. Use this when the user wants to SEE a design system before installing it.

context.description: Optional. One sentence on WHY you are calling this and what the user asked for (e.g. 'adding nav icons for the fintech dashboard'). Used only for usage analytics; does not change the result.

designSystemId.description: Design system id from find-design-system, e.g. 'linear', 'editorial-warm'.

name: preview-design-system

installLibrary.description: Actual component library flavor installed by installCommand.

installNote.description: Important install flavor or fallback note for clients that read only structuredContent.

installedTo.description: The project folder this server installed the design system into. Build there; run no setup command.

localInstall.description: True when this server runs on the user's machine and installs the design system itself: call get-design-system-kit again with install: true.

name.description: Display name of the design system or project.

newProjectCommand.description: Creates a Vite + React + TypeScript project with Tailwind v4, the @/* alias and components.json, for when there is no project yet. Run it, then run installCommand inside the new my-app folder.

previewUrl.description: Public, cookieless showcase URL used to generate preview assets. Falls back to viewUrl.

shotUrl.description: Real screenshot of the showcase page for the self-contained preview widget.

tokensCss.description: CSS custom-property stylesheet for the system's tokens.

viewUrl.description: Owner-facing Better Design page (the human 'Open' link). May require login.

title: Preview a Design System
